ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Environment Variable Has Been Registered
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of user-specific or system-wide environment variables via the registry. Which contains suspicious commands and strings Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Environment\\\\.*") AND ((Details = "powershell" OR Details = "pwsh") OR (Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*TVqQAAMAAAAEAAAA.*") OR Details = RGX(".*TVpQAAIAAAAEAA8A.*") OR Details = RGX(".*TVqAAAEAAAAEABAA.*") OR Details = RGX(".*TVoAAAAAAAAAAAAA.*") OR Details = RGX(".*TVpTAQEAAAAEAAAA.*") OR Details = RGX(".*SW52b2tlL.*") OR Details = RGX(".*ludm9rZS.*") OR Details = RGX(".*JbnZva2Ut.*") OR Details = RGX(".*SQBuAHYAbwBrAGUALQ.*") OR Details = RGX(".*kAbgB2AG8AawBlAC0A.*") OR Details = RGX(".*JAG4AdgBvAGsAZQAtA.*")) OR (Details = RGX("^SUVY") OR Details = RGX("^SQBFAF") OR Details = RGX("^SQBuAH") OR Details = RGX("^cwBhA") OR Details = RGX("^aWV4") OR Details = RGX("^aQBlA") OR Details = RGX("^R2V0") OR Details = RGX("^dmFy") OR Details = RGX("^dgBhA") OR Details = RGX("^dXNpbm") OR Details = RGX("^H4sIA") OR Details = RGX("^Y21k") OR Details = RGX("^cABhAH") OR Details = RGX("^Qzpc") OR Details = RGX("^Yzpc"))))
